definitions.explanation: Inside or beneath the surface of water. Used as a noun or as a modifier with の to describe things that exist or happen underwater.

examples.japanese: {水中|すいちゅう}⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took photos of fish with an underwater camera.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧{水中|すいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沈|しず}んでいた→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧。
examples.english: These ruins had been submerged underwater for a long time.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a standalone noun ({水中|すいちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ — in the water) and as a noun modifier ({水中|すいちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ — underwater [adjective]). Common in compound words related to aquatic activities and equipment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水中|すいちゅう}⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧: underwater camera
- {水中|すいちゅう}⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧: swimming goggles
- {水中|すいちゅう}⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧: underwater photography
- {水中|すいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沈|しず}む→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧: to sink underwater
